const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lat = 40.923221;
  const lon = 104.238631; // Note: ee.Geometry.Point expects [lon, lat]
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(50000); // 50 km radius
  const period2019 = {start: '2019-02-01', end: '2019-03-01'};
  const period2020 = {start: '2020-02-01', end: '2020-03-01'};

  function fmt(n, digits = 1) {
    if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return 'null';
    return Number(n).toFixed(digits);
  }

  async function camsStats(start, end) {
    try {
      // ECMWF CAMS NRT PM2.5; units are kg/m3, convert to ug/m3 by * 1e9
      let col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/CAMS/NRT')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('pm2p5');
      const nImg = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (!nImg || nImg === 0) return {empty: true, nImg: 0};

      const comp = col.mean();
      const compUg = comp.multiply(1e9).rename('pm25_ugm3');

      const count = await compUg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('pm25_ugm3').getInfo();

      if (!count || count === 0) return {empty: false, nImg, noValid: true, count: count || 0};

      const mean = await compUg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('pm25_ugm3').getInfo();

      return {empty: false, dataset: 'CAMS', nImg, count, mean};
    } catch (e) {
      return {error: true, message: e.toString()};
    }
  }

  async function openaqStats(start, end) {
    try {
      const fc = ee.FeatureCollection('OPENAQ')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('parameter', 'pm25'))
        .filterBounds(geom);

      const n = await fc.size().getInfo();
      if (!n || n === 0) return {empty: true, n: 0};

      const valid = fc.filter(ee.Filter.and(
        ee.Filter.notNull(['value']),
        ee.Filter.gte('value', 0),
        ee.Filter.lte('value', 10000)
      ));

      const nv = await valid.size().getInfo();
      if (!nv || nv === 0) return {empty: false, noValid: true, n, count: 0};

      const mean = await valid.aggregate_mean('value').getInfo();
      return {empty: false, dataset: 'OPENAQ', n, count: nv, mean};
    } catch (e) {
      return {error: true, message: e.toString()};
    }
  }

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
  let s19 = await camsStats(period2019.start, period2019.end);
  let s20 = await camsStats(period2020.start, period2020.end);
  let datasetUsed = 'CAMS';

  const camsUsable = !(s19.error || s20.error) && !s19.empty && !s20.empty && !s19.noValid && !s20.noValid;

  if (!camsUsable) {
    console.log(`CAMS status: 2019(empty:${!!s19.empty}, noValid:${!!s19.noValid}, err:${!!s19.error}) 2020(empty:${!!s20.empty}, noValid:${!!s20.noValid}, err:${!!s20.error})`);
    console.log('Falling back to OpenAQ station measurements.');
    s19 = await openaqStats(period2019.start, period2019.end);
    s20 = await openaqStats(period2020.start, period2020.end);
    datasetUsed = 'OPENAQ';
  }

  // 3. Processing and Validation
  if (s19.error || s20.error) {
    console.log('Processing error encountered.');
    console.log('D');
    return;
  }

  if (s19.empty || s20.empty) {
    console.log(`Empty collection in ${datasetUsed}: 2019_empty=${!!s19.empty}, 2020_empty=${!!s20.empty}`);
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  if (s19.noValid || s20.noValid) {
    console.log(`No valid samples after filtering in ${datasetUsed}: 2019_noValid=${!!s19.noValid}, 2020_noValid=${!!s20.noValid}`);
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  const m19 = s19.mean;
  const m20 = s20.mean;

  const invalid19 = (m19 === null || isNaN(m19) || m19 < 0 || m19 > 100000);
  const invalid20 = (m20 === null || isNaN(m20) || m20 < 0 || m20 > 100000);
  if (invalid19 || invalid20) {
    console.log(`Invalid values detected. 2019:${m19} 2020:${m20}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Evidence Output (concise)
  if (datasetUsed === 'CAMS') {
    console.log('Dataset: ECMWF/CAMS/NRT pm2p5 (converted to ug/m3)');
    console.log(`2019-02 Images: ${s19.nImg}, ValidPx: ${s19.count}, Mean(ug/m3): ${fmt(m19, 1)}`);
    console.log(`2020-02 Images: ${s20.nImg}, ValidPx: ${s20.count}, Mean(ug/m3): ${fmt(m20, 1)}`);
  } else {
    console.log('Dataset: OpenAQ station measurements (pm25, ug/m3)');
    console.log(`2019-02 Measurements: ${s19.n}, Valid: ${s19.count}, Mean(ug/m3): ${fmt(m19, 1)}`);
    console.log(`2020-02 Measurements: ${s20.n}, Valid: ${s20.count}, Mean(ug/m3): ${fmt(m20, 1)}`);
  }
  console.log(`Delta(2020-2019) ug/m3: ${fmt(m20 - m19, 1)}`);

  // 5. Final Answer
  if (m20 > m19) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
